aboutus.desc: Al-Barkaat Overseas-ah hian kan lo lawm a che u, chutah chuan tradition leh innovation te chu khawvela floor covering mawi tak tak te nen an inhmu a ni. Rugs kan duhna hi fiber tinah a zung kai tlat a, luxury, comfort, leh cultural richness epitomize tu fine rugs assortment meticulously curated assortment in hnenah kan rawn hlan hi kan chhuang hle a ni. I space-ah hian tradition lumna, tunlai design-a hipna, emaw, a pahnih inzawmkhawm emaw, infuse i tum emaw, kan rugs te hi décor mai mai paltlang a, i in emaw office emaw-a ro hlu hlu tak ni tura siam a ni. Kut thiamna leh ro hlu inzawmkhawmna ram, hun kal tawha thil thleng ngai lo design-te’n tunlai sensibilities nena inzawmkhawmna ramah lut rawh – Al-Barkaat Overseas-ah hian i mimal style tihlawhtling tur leh i chenna hmun chawisang thei tur rug ṭha ber hmuchhuak rawh.
aboutus.service1: Unveiling Extraordinary Value: Kan mission chu inelna man tlawm hmanga i thil tawn tihhausak, thawhhona siam, leh service danglam bik pekna kawngah a innghat a ni.
aboutus.service2: Elevating Excellence: Kan zinkawng hi famkimna zawn chhuahna kawngah a innghat a ni. Thil thar siamna lama inpekna nasa tak leh i lungawina sang ber neih theihna tura inpekna nghet tak nen, industry benchmark-te chu siam thar leh kan tum a ni. Nakin hun êng zawk, hausa zawk lam pan tura kan zinkawng kan zawh dawn hian min rawn zawm ve rawh.
aboutus.service3: Infinite Possibilities Embracing: Kan vision chu horizons piah lamah a zau a, ni tin kan pawm a, hmasawnna leh evolution hun remchang thar nen a khat a ni. Thil thar, hmasawnna, leh theihna tawp nei lo hmanga fueled hmalam hun atana inpe, naktuk chanchin siam tura min rawn zawm turin kan sawm a che u.
aboutus.service4: Crafting Value, Ensuring Excellence: Industry-a man tlawm ber berte kan pe thei che u hi kan chhuang hle. Cost-efficiency leh strategic sourcing kan zawn chhunzawm zel hian i tan sum khawlkhawm tam tak kan tizau thei a ni. Affordability hian service emaw product emaw i dawn quality a tichhe ngai lo tih kan ring tlat a ni. Chutiang chuan, hlutna leh ṭhatna tluk loh pek chhuah kawngah ngaihtuahna nghet tak kan vawng reng a ni.
